## Functional summary

This 98-amino-acid protein is an **integration host factor (IHF) subunit alpha**, a small bacterial DNA-binding protein. The sequence exactly matches the reviewed *Idiomarina loihiensis* IHF alpha reference (100% identity and coverage; UniProt Q5QXL9). Strong matches to *E. coli* IHF alpha proteins provide additional support.

IHF is one subunit of a DNA-binding complex involved in genetic recombination and in regulation of transcription and translation. The reference annotation also places it in the cytosol and associates it with DNA binding and chromatin structure.

## Sequence properties

- **Length:** 98 aa
- **Calculated molecular mass:** about 11.14 kDa
- **Theoretical pI:** about 7.97
- **Pfam matches:** Bac_DNA_binding (PF00216; residues 3–91) and HU-HIG (PF18291; residues 6–94)

These physical properties are sequence-derived estimates. Functional and localization descriptions come from the exact-match reference annotation; they are not independent experimental measurements of the supplied sequence.
